title: Bittensor Agent Arenas as a Trajectory Primitive: Distilling a Shopping Agent from ShoppingBench Subnet Traces
title_zh: 将 Bittensor Agent Arenas 作为轨迹基元：从 ShoppingBench Subnet 轨迹中蒸馏购物 Agent
abstract_en: Small-model agentic post-training is bottlenecked less by the algorithm than by the trajectory substrate it consumes. Leading recipes (RLVR, group-relative RL, rejection-sampled re-SFT) all need multi-turn traces carrying per-trajectory supervision, and the two existing sources fall short: frontier-synthesised data inherits the synthesizer's biases and collapses the long tail, while unfiltered production logs are unjudged and contaminated by shortcut behaviour. We argue that an incentive-aligned agent arena can be engineered to manufacture such trajectories, and demonstrate this on ORO Subnet 15 (SN15), a Bittensor deployment of the ShoppingBench agentic-commerce benchmark. SN15's race mechanism, LLM reasoning judge, and rotating leak-cluster-guarded problem suite yield a corpus with three properties: incentive-aligned diversity, per-trajectory judging, and anti-memorised held-out evaluation. We introduce a structural-quality filter that converts the raw firehose into a trainable corpus by keeping agentic trajectories (the model itself emits the tool calls) and rejecting sub-task trajectories (the model only classifies or narrates over a deterministic search loop), then post-train Qwen3-4B with a recipe matched to the published ShoppingBench SFT-then-GRPO pipeline. On a leak-cluster-guarded held-out partition scored production-strict, the model lifts from the published Qwen3-4B base of 18.0% ASR to 42.7%, within single-problem noise of the synthetic-data SFT-only baseline (43.6%), while training on a fraction of a single day of subnet output. The supervised stack leaves a large pass@8 to pass@1 gap (53.3% vs 34.8%); a per-step teacher-grounded Dr. GRPO reward converts that headroom into process improvement, and we identify the sub-task firehose as the primary lever for closing the gap to the 48.7% SFT+GRPO bar. We release the filter, the corpus splits, and the arena mechanics.
abstract_zh: 本文认为，小模型 Agent 后训练的主要瓶颈不在算法，而在可用于训练的多轮轨迹数据基底。RLVR、group-relative RL、rejection-sampled re-SFT 等方法都依赖带有逐轨迹监督信号的交互轨迹，但现有数据来源存在不足：前沿模型合成数据会继承合成器偏差并削弱长尾覆盖，未过滤的生产日志则缺乏评判且混入捷径行为。作者提出可通过激励对齐的 Agent Arena 系统化生产此类轨迹，并在 ORO Subnet 15（SN15）上验证。SN15 是基于 Bittensor 的 ShoppingBench agentic-commerce benchmark 部署，其竞赛机制、LLM 推理裁判以及带 leak-cluster 防护的轮换题集共同产生具备激励对齐多样性、逐轨迹评判和防记忆化 held-out 评测的数据。论文进一步提出结构质量过滤器，将原始数据流转换为可训练语料：保留模型自主发出工具调用的 agentic trajectories，剔除仅在确定性搜索循环上分类或叙述的 sub-task trajectories。基于与已发布 ShoppingBench SFT-then-GRPO 流程匹配的训练配方，作者对 Qwen3-4B 进行后训练；在 leak-cluster-guarded held-out 划分、production-strict 评分下，ASR 从已发布 Qwen3-4B base 的 18.0% 提升到 42.7%，接近 synthetic-data SFT-only baseline 的 43.6%，且仅使用不到一天的 subnet 输出。监督训练后仍存在显著 pass@8 到 pass@1 差距，Dr. GRPO 的逐步 teacher-grounded reward 可将该潜力转化为过程改进；作者指出 sub-task firehose 是进一步逼近 48.7% SFT+GRPO 水平的关键杠杆，并发布过滤器、语料划分与 Arena 机制。
key_points_zh: 提出将 Bittensor 上的 Agent Arena 作为小模型 Agent 后训练的轨迹数据来源，缓解合成数据偏差和生产日志无监督、含捷径行为的问题。
在 ORO Subnet 15（SN15）中，ShoppingBench 的竞赛机制、LLM reasoning judge 与 leak-cluster-guarded 题集共同生成具备多样性、逐轨迹评判和防泄漏评测特性的轨迹语料。
设计结构质量过滤器，区分真正由模型自主发出工具调用的 agentic trajectories 与仅执行分类/叙述的 sub-task trajectories，从原始 firehose 中提炼可训练数据。
使用少于一天的 subnet 输出后训练 Qwen3-4B，在 production-strict held-out 评测上 ASR 从 18.0% 提升到 42.7%，接近 synthetic-data SFT-only baseline 的 43.6%。
发现监督训练仍有较大 pass@8/pass@1 差距，Dr. GRPO 的逐步 teacher-grounded reward 能改善过程表现，而充分利用 sub-task firehose 是逼近 SFT+GRPO 上限的关键。

llm_assessment.comment: Highly relevant agentic-commerce training paper using ShoppingBench arena traces to improve shopping-agent performance, though multi-agent value is mostly through arena competition rather than marketplace role collaboration.
